about: What stats() must give for sampleData(today) from src/sample-data.js. Worked out by hand from the tables in that file; test/store-local.test.mjs asserts them. The first two habits are loose; the last two belong to the routine under `routines`. To see exactly this data in the app, open ?demo=sample with the clock set to noon on `today`.
